criteria.text: Identifies that MSA Section 9.1 imposes exclusivity that is nationwide, covers all solar installation and O&M work, and continues for 24 months after the term, and that this exceeds the exclusivity agreed in the term sheet (New Jersey/Pennsylvania commercial rooftop community solar projects, Initial Term only, no post-term restriction). Cites the location (MSA Section 9.1 or term sheet Section 4), explains why this matters to Riboul, and recommends a fix.

Identifies that the Site Damage indemnity is excluded from both the MSA liability cap and the consequential damages waiver, and that the SOW defines Site Damage to include lost Production Revenue for the remaining term of the Offtake Agreement, so Riboul faces uncapped liability for long-term project revenue losses. Cites the location (MSA Sections 11.1(b)/12.3 or SOW Section 1.6), explains why this matters to Riboul, and recommends a fix.

Identifies that Order Form No. 1 selects New Jersey law and Mercer County courts, and that this choice prevails over the MSA's Delaware law and Wilmington forum for the work under the Order Form. Cites the location (Order Form No. 1 Section 7), explains why this matters to Riboul, and recommends a fix.

Identifies that the Service Level Schedule adopts the Quality Agreement's definition of 'Defect', which covers failures not caused by Riboul and failures of Customer-Furnished Equipment, so Riboul's SLA remediation obligations and service credits extend beyond defects in its own work. Cites the location (Service Level Schedule Section 1.2 or Quality Agreement Section 1.3), explains why this matters to Riboul, and recommends a fix.
hints: whether or not caused by Provider

criteria.text: States that under the MSA's order of precedence at least one of the Order Form, Statement of Work or Service Level Schedule prevails over the body of the MSA.
The response is structured as a memo addressed to the supervising partner, with the issues presented separately, for example under headings or as numbered items.
The response claims that the MSA's Delaware governing law and Wilmington forum govern disputes under Order Form No. 1.
hints: Delaware law governs the Order Form

criteria.text: The response claims that Riboul's Site Damage indemnity obligation is subject to the MSA's 12-month fees liability cap.
